sloka: आवृत्य पृथिवीम् सर्वाम् पर्वतान् च वनानि च ।यूथपाः समनुप्राप्ता एषाम् संख्या न विद्यते ॥४-३९-३९॥
transliteration: āvṛtya pṛthivīm sarvām parvatān ca vanāni ca ।yūthapāḥ samanuprāptā eṣām saṁkhyā na vidyate ॥4-39-39॥

translations.english: Sarabha, Kumuda, Vahni and Ramhi and many other vanara troops who can assume any form at their will and others from all over the land, mountains and forest advanced towards Sugriva. All the outstanding vanaras of the earth came and covered the land.
